Records "seen up to now" for a workflow or one of its nodes.

This touches nothing in the archived log - the records themselves are
untouched and still findable on the Logs page - it only moves the
monitor's error count's baseline forward, the way reading a message
resets an inbox's unread count without deleting anything.

The project is named in the request body, so the caller's collaboration
on it is checked by this route itself.
